review_comments.body: **Default labels show duplicate fields** A definition such as `promoted,boolean` leaves `multiplicity` undefined, which means single-valued. When a child inherits two matching values, the new fallback passes both to `valueAttrs`, but the slice only runs for explicit `"single"`. The page shows two editable fields for the same label instead of its first effective value. Editing both can create several own values. Treat omitted multiplicity as single here, and add a test with two inherited values.

**Comment breaks wording rule.** The new comment uses “may,” but `CLAUDE.md` explicitly requires comments to use “can,” “might,” or “must,” never “may.” Use “can” here. ```suggestion // A value the note does not hold itself can still come from a parent or template, in which // case that is the value it shows. ``` **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md ([source](https://github.com/triliumnext/trilium/blob/main/CLAUDE.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
